items.text: Geedaha si tartiib tartiib ah u cagaaraan oo farxadaa ku keena. Wax kastaa si run ah u cusbonaanayaa.
items.q: Someone praises spring. Is it clear everything only seems to become fresh again?
before: – Aad u yar. Qaar waxay xafladayn karaan xafladii yar ee maalinta ugu horreysa ee gu'ga. Laakiin sanadoodu cusub wuxuu ku yimaadaa dhinac Yaldaa habeenkeenna.
– Mm-hm, garatay. Laakiin haddaad waydiiso, sanadka cusub waa inuu gu'ga yimaadaa.

items.text: – Ka dibna ka fikir waxa Baaba aan jacaylka ah uu soo marayo – guriga oo dhan joogay sannadahaan oo dhan.
items.q: Is it clear poor Baba has sat idle at home all these years?
before: …waxa keliya ee ay lahayd waxay ahayd inay fadhiisato dhammaadka luuqa. Waxay tidhi: qalbigaygu wuu qudhmayaa. Anigu ugu yaraan tolidda ayaan xoogaa isku mashquuliyaa, xataa marka carruurtu maqan yihiin. Shaqadu way wanaagsan tahay, Amiir. Markaan shaqo la'aan ahay, marnaba uma adkaysan karo.
Qaasim ayaa yiri, isagoo qosol adkayn:

items.text: Guriga Daawuud ayaan arkay. Duntu gacantayda bay ku jirtay.
items.q: A small boy holds a thread to find his way. Is 'Duntu' right?
before: …oo wixii cadaa madaxayga ka jiiday, banaankana igu riixay. Haddana waan sii socday. Meeshii aan hore ugu dhacay, gacantayda ayaan ishayda saaray. Si qarsoodi ah ayaan farahayga dhexdooda uga eegay. Hadda haddii aan tago, gacantayda indhahayga ma saarayo. Baaskiil ma jirin. Haddana waan sii socday.

items.text: – Nin yahow, aad baad u caajis tahay. Goormaan waxan oo kale idhi?
items.q: Someone teases him for acting like a baby. Is 'caajis' the right word?
before: …waday: – Runtii ma fahmi karo waxa aad iga jeclaatay. Isku-soo-ururinta sunaha indhahayga? Dirirtayda? Mise sida aan ula sheekaysto qof kasta adiga mooyaane? Ma jirtaa wax ka murugo badan inaad fadhiisato oo aad i daawato anigoo dadka kale oo dhan, gaar ahaan qofkaas gaarka ah, la sheekaysanaya?
– Aad bay ii murugaysaa, laakiin habeen iyo maalin lama qaylin karo dadka Ilaah. Ma tago oo Siinaa la diriraa?

items.text: – Bilowga bisha Esfand waa nooc ka mid ah wakhtigee imtixaan?
items.q: Is it clear the speaker asks since when exams are held in early Esfand?
before: – Mar kale Fiisigis Labaad eber baan ka dhacay. Aad baan u dhibban ahay.

items.text: Mala-awaalkaygana, maalin kasta, marka Niluufar iyo Siinaa ay is arkaan, way is gacan qaadaan.
items.q: Is it clear Niloofar and Sina shake hands when they meet?
before: …qof walba ku eegayey. Habeenkaas ka dib, wax aan dhageysanno ma haynnin. Mar kale, sidii maalmihii ka horreeyey Walkman-ka, ka dib markii iftiinka guriga Negaar uu damo, waxaan tagi jirnay oo halkaas, daboolka xafadda jidka weyn, aan ku fadhiisan jirnay oo aan daawan jirnay gawaarida ag maraya.
Maalintaas ka dib, Niluufar mar dambe lama socon gabdhaha kale ee fasalka xagga kushkii Yacquub fasalka ka dib. Si toos ah ayay jaamacadda uga bixi jirtay.

items.text: – Khamri-haan bay ka eg tahay weel.
items.q: Is it clear it looks more like a big clay jar than a vase?
before: – Hamoon, ma leedahay waxa loo yaqaan jidh qaab weel ubax lagu rido leh?

items.text: Ka hor inta aan helo fursad aan ku idhaahdo waxa ahaa kaftan, feedhka Xamiid si toos ah ayuu u dhacay bartamaha sankayga.
items.q: Hamid punches him on the nose. Is 'feedhka' the right word for fist?
before: – Tag oo Xamiid koofiyaddiisa ka qaad oo madaxa bidaarta leh gadaashiisa ka dhar, haddii kale maanta marka Negaar soo baxdo waxaan kor u qaadayaa Yaasi-caatada ee madaxayga, markaas waxaa hadhaya adiga iyo Xamiid Bisad.

…shabeelka ayaa sii xoogaystay. Anigoo cabsi la gariiraya ayaan koofiyadda Xamiid ka qaaday oo si aad u tartiib ah ayaan madaxiisa gadaashiisa uga dharay, si aan Taqii raalli ugu hayo, oo aan xanaaqa Xamiid ka nabad gelo sidoo kale. Markaas si taxaddar leh ayaan koofiyadda meesheeda dib u dhigay.

items.text: Adiguna, habkaas gus-ka ah ee aad u hadasho awgiis, magacaagu wuxuu ahaan lahaa Alain Guslon.
items.q: 'Alain Guslon' is meant as a rude pun on the actor Alain Delon. Would Somali readers get it? If not, what word could carry it?
before: – Haa, Haamuun magac fiican baa kuu ah. Sida Haamuun-ka filimka, adiguna su'aalo baad ka buuxdaa. Walaac baad ka buuxdaa, waxaadna tahay il welwel, ma aha naftaada, laakiin aniga.
